description: Source code for the LeaveOverlapAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for retrieving overlapping leave requests in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It handles query parameters, invokes leave service methods, and formats the response.

classes.name: LeaveOverlapAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for retrieving overlapping leave requests, extending the Endpoint base class and implementing CollectionEndpoint interface.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve overlapping leaves, possibly including work shift length exceeding logic, and returns results as an EndpointCollectionResult.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, modifying common parameter validation.

methods.name: getLeaveApplicationService
methods.description: Lazy initialization and retrieval of the LeaveApplicationService instance.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeIdParam
methods.description: Override to reuse LeaveRequestParamHelperTrait::class with LeaveOverlapParams::class. Returns 0.

methods.name: getFromDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves 'fromDate' parameter as DateTime or null from request.

methods.name: getToDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves 'toDate' parameter as DateTime or null from request.

methods.name: getDurationParam
methods.description: Retrieves an array of duration-related parameters from the request.

methods.description: Retrieves 'partialOption' string parameter from the request.
